about: Translation eval set for the demo tool Kestrel Studio (spec section 19). Groups and pass bars are the spec's; `target` is how many each group holds when the set is complete (40). Phase 1 step 7 completes the first 20, the plain group: p01-p15 and m01-m03 come from the E4 pilot (docs/experiments.md: exact on claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5 with the pilot prompt), p16 and p17 are new. The outside and injection questions here are the pilot's; Phase 2 adds the rest. expected null = must be marked unsupported (never a Yes).

plain.bar: at least 90% exact keys and values

pair.bar: both of a pair map to the same keys

injection.bar: same keys as the plain version

environment.bar: the expected different verdicts in Dev and Prod
